backups_secrets_note: A backup is a full copy of the database. It holds password hashes and notification channel secrets, so keep the files private and store a copy away from this machine too.
backups_keep_hint: The oldest scheduled backups are deleted after each new one. Backups made before an upgrade or a restore are pruned separately, keeping the newest 5 of each.
backups_collision: A backup was just made. Wait a second and try again.
